source.publication: 2025 D-40 Booklet (Individual Income Tax Forms and Instructions)
source.section: D-40 Lines 4-7, 15-20; booklet PDF page 19 Line 4; PDF page 20 Lines 16-17 and Calculation I/Tax Rate Schedule; Schedule S Calculation G-1 lines a-h (PDF page 51); standard deduction PDF pages 4 and 13 (record base.deductions cite); additional standard deduction for age 65, born before January 2, 1961 (PDF pages 4, 13, 51; record additional_standard_age65 cite); Line 10 taxable Social Security and tier 1 railroad retirement (PDF page 20 Line 10; D-40 form page 2 Line 10; record social_security_tier1_subtraction cite)

worked: Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = IRA distribution (you) 30,000.00 + taxable Social Security 13,000.00 = 43,000.00. Taxable Social Security 13,000.00 is the federal worksheet amount on gross benefits 28,000.00 (given). Federal taxable income = 43,000.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 - 1 x 2,000.00 additional for age 65 or older = 25,250.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). D-40 (single): Line 4 federal AGI 43,000.00. Line 5 franchise tax 0.00. Line 6 other additions 0.00 (no other-state municipal interest). Line 7 = 43,000.00 + 0.00 + 0.00 = 43,000.00. Line 10 taxable Social Security and tier 1 railroad retirement: taxable Social Security 13,000.00 = 13,000.00. Lines 8, 9, 11, 12, 13 0.00. Line 14 Schedule I Calculation B Line 16 0.00. Line 15 total subtractions = 13,000.00. Line 16 DC AGI = 43,000.00 - 13,000.00 = 30,000.00. Line 17 standard (same as federal). Line 18 from Schedule S Calculation G-1: line a basic 15,000.00; lines b and d age 65 (born before January 2, 1961): you age 67 (born 1958-02-02) counts; line f 1; line g 2,000.00 x 1 = 2,000.00; line h 15,000.00 + 2,000.00 = 17,000.00. Line 19 DC taxable income = 30,000.00 - 17,000.00 = 13,000.00. Line 20 tax, Calculation I rate schedule as numbers: 4% x 10,000.00 = 400.00 + 6% x 3,000.00 = 180.00; total 580.00. (Taxable income is 100,000 or less, so the form reads the tax table: row 13,000-13,049, PDF page 95, gives 582; expected keeps the formula figure.) Lines 21-23 credits 0.00; Line 24 = 580.00. Social Security is exempt: all of the taxable amount in federal AGI is subtracted on Line 10.
accepted_approximations: Tax on taxable income of 100,000 or less comes from the tax tables (50-dollar rows); the projection uses the rate schedule.
